text:
Sara M: Ok team — quick micro-sprint to sharpen competitor soundbites for the launch webinar + benchmark post. Goal = 3 crisp claims vs cloud AI platforms, 3 vs LLM APIs, 3 vs infra vendors. We need A/B test candidates for landing. @Alex D @Mike S FYI

Alex D: nice. can we get a one-liner per axis? i can validate accuracy vs our perf docs.

Mike S: Sales needs 2 versions: short (audience-facing) + long (field play). short = 1 sentence, long = 2-3 bullets.

Priya R: i'll wireframe the landing test and inbound routing rules. pref to send higher intent leads to AE queue if they click 'dedicated' or 'private'.

Eli K: from the evals side — we'll provide bench numbers and variance bands. want to avoid absolute claims, use 'up to' + percent ranges. also add latency examples for 2 seq lengths.

Jenna C: draft soundbites below — choose favorites, i'll polish copy.
```
Vs cloud AI platforms:
- 'Predictable inference economics where others surprise you with hidden egress and latency costs.'
- 'Same API, fewer late-night incidents — built-in fallbacks & routing keep apps online.'

Vs LLM APIs:
- 'Control your model stack and deployment modes — hosted, dedicated, private.'
- 'Ship prod-grade LLM features without owning the entire serving stack.'

Vs infra vendors:
- 'We do the heavy inference optimizations so you don't.'
- 'Instantly deployable, observability-first runtime tuned for tail latency.'
```

Sara M: love these. vote with 👍/👎 in channel. @webinar-bot can you add a 30-min slot on Thu for review?

webinar-bot: Scheduled: Thu 09:30 — Microrebut copy review (30m)

Alex D: minor nit: replace 'hidden egress' with 'surprise egress and throttling fees' — more concrete.

Mike S: field wants an objection handler quick script for procurement: 2 lines about pricing model + where to escalate.

Priya R: inbound routing note: route 'dedicated capacity' clicks => AE high-intent; 'hosted API' => nurture with benchmark content. tagging rules: utm_campaign=bench_launch

Eli K: i'll drop two latency datapoints and a small chart PNG into the doc later.

Jenna C: i'll iterate and post A/B variants by EOD. Sara — want to run a small betacohort on the webinar landing?

Sara M: yes, 5% of traffic for 48h. thanks everyone — let's aim to finalize copy by tomorrow noon :rocket:
